main_effect: When you encounter Time Distortion, reverse the game's turn order. (For example, if play had proceeded clockwise around the table, it now goes counterclockwise. Then planeswalk away from this phenomenon.)

name: Towashi
main_effect: Modified creatures you control have trample and "Whenever this creature deals combat damage to a player or planeswalker, draw a card." (Equipment, Auras you control, and counters are modifications.)
chaos_effect: Whenever you roll {Chaos}, distribute three +1/+1 counters among one, two, or three target creatures you control.

name: Trail of the Mage-Rings
main_effect: Instant and sorcery spells have rebound. (The spell's controller exiles the spell as it resolves if they cast it from their hand. At the beginning of that player's next upkeep, they may cast that card from exile without paying its mana cost.)
chaos_effect: Whenever you roll {Chaos}, you may search your library for an instant or sorcery card, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle.

name: Truga Jungle
main_effect: All lands have "{T}: Add one mana of any color."
chaos_effect: Whenever you roll {Chaos}, reveal the top three cards of your library. Put all land cards revealed this way into your hand and the rest on the bottom of your library in any order.

name: Turri Island
main_effect: Creature spells cost {2} less to cast.
chaos_effect: Whenever you roll {Chaos}, reveal the top three cards of your library. Put all creature cards revealed this way into your hand and the rest into your graveyard.

name: Two Streams Facility
main_effect:
Whenever you planeswalk to Two Streams Facility and at the beginning of the first upkeep of the game, each player chooses green anchor or red waterfall.
Each player who last chose green anchor may play an additional land during each of their turns.
Creatures controlled by players who last chose red waterfall get +2/+0 and have haste.
chaos_effect: Whenever you roll {Chaos}, each player who last chose green anchor chooses red waterfall, and vice versa.

name: Undercity Reaches
main_effect: Whenever a creature deals combat damage to a player, its controller may draw a card.
chaos_effect: Whenever you roll {Chaos}, you have no maximum hand size for the rest of the game.

name: UNIT Headquarters
main_effect: When you planeswalk to UNIT Headquarters and at the beginning of your upkeep, create a tapped 1/1 white Soldier creature token.
chaos_effect: Whenever you roll {Chaos}, put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.

name: Unknown Event
main_effect: When you encounter this, Each player opens a Magic the Gathering booster pack. They may select up to two cards from that pack and exile them face down. For the rest of the game, players may look at and play cards exiled this way without paying their mana costs. (Then Planeswalk away from this phenomenon.)

name: Unleash the Flux
main_effect: When you encounter Unleash the Flux, each player sacrifices a nonland permanent of their choice, then you flip a coin. If you lose the flip, repeat this process. (Then planeswalk away from this phenomenon.)

name: Unyaro
main_effect: At the beginning of your end step, if you planeswalked to Unyaro this turn, untap all creatures. They phase out until a player planeswalks. (Treat them and anything attached to them as though they didn't exist.)
chaos_effect: Whenever you roll {Chaos}, create two 2/2 white and blue Knight creature tokens with vigilance.

name: Valor's Reach
main_effect: Whenever your team attacks with exactly two creatures, those creatures gain double strike until end of turn.
chaos_effect: Whenever you roll {Chaos}, untap up to two target creatures your team controls. If it's a main phase, there is an additional combat phase after this phase, followed by an additional main phase.

name: Velis Vel
main_effect: Each creature gets +1/+1 for each other creature on the battlefield that shares at least one creature type with it. (For example, if two Elemental Shamans and an Elemental Spirit are on the battlefield, each gets +2/+2.)
chaos_effect: Whenever you roll {Chaos}, target creature gains all creature types until end of turn.

name: We Hope You Like Squirrels
main_effect: At the beginning of each player's upkeep and whenever a player casts a spell, that player creates a 1/1 green Squirrel creature token.
chaos_effect: Whenever you roll {Chaos}, put a +1/+1 counter on each Squirrel you control.

name: Welcome to Valley
main_effect:
Whenever you cast an animal spell, draw a card. (Animals are any non-human creature types that are animals in real life.)
Whenever Chaos ensues, create a token that's a copy of target creature you control, except it's a 1/1.

name: Windmill Farm
main_effect:
When you planeswalk here and at the beginning of your upkeep, create a Tulip Petal artifact token that has "{T}, Sacrifice this artifact: Add one mana of any color."
Chaos: Spin this plane until the arrow lands on a permanent. If the plane rotated at least 360 degrees during the spin, create a token that's a copy of that permanent.

name: Windriddle Palaces
main_effect:
Players play with the top card of their libraries revealed.
You may play lands and cast spells from the top of any player's library.
chaos_effect: Whenever you roll {Chaos}, each player mills a card.

name: Year-End Review
main_effect: Each player may choose a nontoken creature they own on the battlefield, reveal a creature card from their hand, or choose a creature card in their graveyard. Those cards become promoted to commander. Each player may put their new commander into the com- mand zone. Then planeswalk away from this phenom- enon. (All original commanders are still commanders.)
